tweetText: Five AI industry leaders discussed major issues at the Milken Global Conference, including chip shortages and flaws in the tech's underlying architecture. Their insights highlight critical challenges that could impact the future of AI development. via TechCrunch AI
Barry Diller backs Sam Altman but warns that as we approach AGI, trust alone isn't enough. He stresses the need for safeguards due to AGI's unpredictable nature. via TechCrunch AI

Snap's $400M deal with Perplexity to integrate its AI search engine into Snapchat has ended amicably. This shift highlights the challenges in partnerships within the evolving AI landscape. via TechCrunch AI
xAI might be focusing more on creating data centers than on developing AI models. This shift could change the landscape of AI infrastructure and services. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk's departure from OpenAI was marked by intense negotiations, as revealed by co-founder Greg Brockman. This insight highlights the high-stakes drama behind one of the most influential tech companies today. via TechCrunch AI

DeepSeek, a Chinese AI lab, is poised for a $45B valuation after its first investment round, thanks to its cost-effective large language model. This could shift the balance of AI development away from U.S. dominance. via TechCrunch AI

Google is updating its AI search to include quotes from Reddit and other forums, helping users with niche questions. This could lead to a mix of useful insights and confusion in search results. via TechCrunch AI

Genesis AI, backed by Khosla, has launched its first model, GENE-26.5, along with a demo of robotic hands tackling complex tasks. This marks a significant step in advancing robotics with foundational AI technology. via TechCrunch AI
Match Group is slowing down hiring to manage the costs of new AI tools. This move highlights how AI is impacting company budgets in the tech industry. via TechCrunch AI
Apple will pay $250M to settle a lawsuit over delayed AI features for Siri. This highlights the challenges tech companies face in delivering on ambitious AI promises. via TechCrunch AI
